senses.gloss: f. (כָּשַׁף) engaged in, inclined to sorcery. .
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 7:13:2">Y. Snh. VII, 25ᵈ</cite> top (ref. to <cite ref="Exodus 22:17">Ex. XXII, 17</cite>) (the text speaks only of females) <he>מפני שרוב הנשים כ׳</he> because most women are inclined to sorcery (Bab. ib. 67ᵃ <he>מצויות בכשפים</he>, v. <cite ref="K01318"><he>כֶּשֶׁף</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Yoma 83b:18">Yoma 83ᵇ</cite> <he>נשים כ׳</he> women engaged in sorcery.
